title: Someone is running Qwen 27B at ~20 tok/s on a jailbroken PS5's GPU
hook_text: Twenty tokens per second on a jailbroken PS5.
script:
Twenty tokens per second running Alibaba's Qwen twenty seven B model on a jailbroken PlayStation five.
Developers cobanov and abhi245y built the PS5 LM project to execute local inference.
The console uses a custom AMD chip featuring sixteen gigabytes of shared GDDR6 memory.
Sony locked down the graphics hardware to prevent unapproved custom code execution.
Bypassing those limits lets enthusiasts test massive model weights directly on console silicon.
Running open source weights locally avoids cloud API costs and usage restrictions.
Would you hack your console to run local models?
